span.p:
LOOK AT THE SMEAR
(mandatory, never skip)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PSEUDO-thrombocytopenia
EDTA artifact
Repeat in citrate tube

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THROMBOTIC MICROANGIOPATHY
TTP / HUS / DIC
EMERGENCY - PLEX, never steroids alone

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MARROW DISORDER
Leukemia / MDS / aplasia
Heme referral + biopsy

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Screen for SECONDARY causes
HIV · HCV · H. pylori · quant Ig
ANA/APS, meds, recent heparin

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SECONDARY ITP
Treat the driver first

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PRIMARY ITP
A diagnosis of exclusion
No test confirms it
